overall: The AG found an individual violation by the remotely participating Committee Chair for not stating at the start of a May 17, 2023 executive session that no one else was present at his location; the Chair was ordered to comply and the Committee was cautioned.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee Chair did not state at the start of the May 17, 2023 executive session that no other person was present at his remote location.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find an individual violation of the Open Meeting Law by Mayor Vieau for failing to state at the beginning of the executive session that no other person was present in his remote location.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance by the Chair with the Open Meeting Law's requirements for remote participation in executive session (order to Mayor Vieau).
